map.估算抵消年排放所需的树木与林地。: Estimate the trees and forest land needed to offset annual emissions.
map.树木数 = 年排放 / 单株吸收；林地 = 树木数 / 密度: Trees = annual emissions / uptake per tree; forest land = trees / density
map.仅为粗略估算，未计森林碳汇衰减。: This is a rough estimate and does not account for forest carbon sink decay.
map.活动碳中和：录入排放量，按林地年固碳率求需造林面积与年限。: Event carbon neutrality: enter the emissions and use the annual forest sequestration rate to find the required forestation area and number of years.
map.方案比选：对比造林、购买 CCER 等中和路径的成本与面积。: Option comparison: compare the cost and area of forestation against buying CCER and other offset paths.
map.教学演示：演示排放量与林地固碳能力的平衡关系。: Teaching demo: show the balance between emissions and the carbon sequestration capacity of forest land.
map.示例：年排放 1000 tCO₂、林地固碳 5 tCO₂/亩·年，则约需 200: Example: with annual emissions of 1000 tCO₂ and forest sequestration of 5 tCO₂/mu·year, about 200 mu of forest land sequestering continuously is needed to offset that year.
map.固碳率取多少？: What sequestration rate should be used?
map.因树种林龄而异，常用方法学给区间（如 1–10 tCO₂/亩·年），以备案值为准: It varies with species and stand age; common methodologies give a range (for example 1–10 tCO₂/mu·year), and the filed value takes precedence. Results are estimated according to public standards and environmental factors, for science outreach, teaching and emission-reduction estimates; actual accounting should follow official guidelines (such as the GHG Protocol and provincial carbon emission factors) and measured data.
map.当年种当年抵？: Can planting this year offset this year?
map.林木生长有周期，碳汇分期计入；当年中和常需预购已有碳信用或多年累积。结果按公开标: Trees grow in cycles and the carbon sink is credited in stages; neutralizing the current year usually requires pre-purchased carbon credits or multi-year accumulation. Results are estimated according to public standards and environmental factors, for science outreach, teaching and emission-reduction estimates; actual accounting should follow official guidelines (such as the GHG Protocol and provincial carbon emission factors) and measured data.
map.减排优先于抵消，碳汇多用于剩余难减量的中和，不宜替代直接减排。结果按公开标准与环: Emission reduction takes priority over offsetting; carbon sinks are mainly used to neutralize the remaining hard-to-abate emissions and should not replace direct reductions. Results are estimated according to public standards and environmental factors, for science outreach, teaching and emission-reduction estimates; actual accounting should follow official guidelines (such as the GHG Protocol and provincial carbon emission factors) and measured data.
